name: Cooper's Restaurant (Fish Haven, ID) Bear Lake West Classic Two-Egg Breakfast
brandOrRestaurant: Cooper's Restaurant & Sports Bar (Fish Haven / Bear Lake West, ID)
whyItWorks: A tranquil golf-course morning overlooking Bear Lake with pure, bioavailable protein. Soft scrambled or poached eggs and shredded potato hash browns are zero-roughage.
